items.title: Eurreal Wilford "Little Brother" Montgomery Interview, 1958-05-29
items.q: And Dewey Washington was in the band.

ctx.x: Preston. So Preston made the record. Are there any other records that you might be on that maybe people don't know about? Of course you don't know what people know but I mean the ones you made under your own name and say the Ma Rainey? And can you think of anything else now that people might not have heard about?

Well I made some with Charlie Creff. I mean I mean. Oh you were on them? Yeah I'm on the Charlie Creff records. And of course with the band in Europe with Sam Wooden's band we made a complete catalog of them. Oh yes all of them. We made many records. But those are all known about but. The other the Charlie Creff do you remember the who else was in the band? Was Zutty with them then? No Zutty wasn't with them then. Zutty was in Chicago then. And Dewey Washington was in Chicago. And Dewey Washington was in the…
You were on the boat then one summer, one year about?
